faqs.a:
The city council finds, determines and declares that the neighborhood traffic problems
               threaten the health, safety, welfare and peace of neighborhood residents. It is the
               intent of the city that a process be established that will facilitate the evaluation
               and resolution of neighborhood traffic problems.
(Code 1981, § 17-136; Ord. No. 2923, § 1, 11-19-1992; Ord. No. 3081, § 1, 6-6-1994;
Ord. No. 4561, § 2, 8-29-2016
)
